title: Quentin and the Ember
author: Astrid Hartwell
blurb: Freya Whitlock, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
